{"id":"bdc46938-e72f-4c3d-8e32-c64b53eee342","name":"The Arcane Optograph","cosm":{"id":"af5b89f6-755a-4c5d-bc4b-f0d72251cdd1","name":"Orrorsh"},"clearanceLevel":"ALPHA","publications":[{"id":"d3860743-ea9c-53ef-813c-8b1403d016c9","title":"Orrorsh - A Trifling Matter"}],"possibilities":"3 [possibilities]","tappingDifficulty":"15","purpose":"

To communicate with the dead.

","text":"

The optograph is a tripod-mounted camera and projector that swivels out on a velvet accordion. It can be collapsed into a small portable box when not in use.

","powers":"

If the optograph is placed over the eyes of a person who has been deceased less than 24 hours, it can project a moving image of the everything the victim saw in the last minute before her death. Since it uses local spiritual energy it needs no power source.

","restrictions":"

The optograph's may only be used on Mind or Mind-based skills.
